_about: Services that are KNOWN not to load per database, used by Tools/fresh-clone-matrix.py. A failure not listed here fails the run; a listed one that now loads is reported as 'gap closed - remove it from this list'. The goal is an empty list for every database: Confluence supports SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL in both standalone and grid mode. Names are the plugin assembly names as they appear in 'Error loading plugin <name>.dll'.
